subject: Request: co-marketing voucher pool for CloudRise pilot - terms & fulfillment
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@cloudrise.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus@cloudrise.org>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-marketing voucher pool for our pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at CloudRise is excited to proceed with a small pilot cohort of 8 startups. As discussed, we'd like Redwood to support the cohort with promotional credits that participants can redeem during their 90-day trials.

We have two asks:
- A pool of $12,000 in trial vouchers that we (CloudRise) will distribute to member startups.
- A short promotional terms doc and redemption flow so we can share it in the accelerator portal (no surprises on usage caps or export controls).

Can you confirm internal approval and whether Redwood needs any paperwork (Procurement/DocuSign) or a fiscal sponsor to issue the credits? If you need a formal SOW or invoice, Marcus can loop in our finance lead.

Also attaching the cohort timeline and requested voucher breakdown.

Best,
Elena

[Attachment: cohort_overview.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: requested_voucher_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@cloudrise.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-marketing voucher pool for our pilot

Hi Elena — really appreciate the detailed packet. This sounds like a great fit for a partner-funded voucher pool.

Internal housekeeping: I'm looping in Ben (partnership ops) and Grace (channel finance) to confirm the mechanics and any accounting paperwork. Soojin from the SI partner team is added to confirm the activation flow within the marketplace.

Questions from our side:
1) Do the vouchers need to be single-use per company, or will CloudRise reassign unused vouchers?
2) Any PII or regulatory constraints for the startups (healthcare/finance) we should flag?
3) Preferred payout/fulfillment date — you mentioned Jan 10 in the doc; is that a hard deadline?

Elena — assuming no unusual compliance constraints, we can typically 1) approve partner-sourced vouchers up to $15k with a signed partner agreement and 2) provision promo codes in the marketplace for redemption. If Ben confirms allocation, we'll generate the DocuSign packet for signatures and the voucher batch.

Next step: Ben, can you confirm whether we need a purchase order or just a signed agreement for this type of partner-funded promo? Grace — please confirm whether this will be treated as deferred revenue (partner-sponsored trial) or simple marketing contra.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@cloudrise.org>, Marcus Li <marcus@cloudrise.org>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-marketing voucher pool for our pilot

Jordan / team / Elena — happy to move forward. Summary of internal decisions below: 

- Approval: Partner-funded voucher pool of $12,000 approved (under our $15k fast-track threshold).
- Paperwork: Standard Partner Promo Agreement + DocuSign signature required. No PO required for this amount; CloudRise's signature is sufficient.
- Accounting: Grace, please record as contra-marketing (not deferred revenue).
- Fulfillment timeline: We can provision the promo codes and marketplace redemption page by 2027-01-08 to meet the Jan 10 distribution if CloudRise finalizes signatures by 2026-12-22.

Attachments: promo_terms_draft.pdf, voucher_allocation_template.csv (filled sample).

Elena — attaching our standard promo terms (minor edits added inline). Two small notes for you: (1) we capped per-org redemptions at $2,500 to keep the cohort equitable, and (2) we added a 45-day post-activation usage window so credits don't linger indefinitely. If that works, I'll issue the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Ben

[Attachment: CloudRise_Promo_Terms_2026-12.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: cloudrise_voucher_allocation_20261215.csv (CSV)]

--
Ben Carter
Partnership Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Torres <elena@cloudrise.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus@cloudrise.org>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-marketing voucher pool for our pilot

Ben, Jordan — this all looks good and aligned with how we run the accelerator. The $2,500 per-org cap and 45-day usage window are acceptable.

Please send the DocuSign packet and a link to the marketplace redemption page once provisioned. I'll route the agreement to our legal/finance immediately; our target is to sign by 12/21 to hit your provisioning date.

One small ask: can Redwood include a small co-branded badge (CloudRise + Redwood) for us to surface in the cohort portal? If yes, I'll send logo assets in a follow-up.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — excited to get the cohort live.

Best,
Elena

[Attachment: cohort_asset_requirements.txt (TXT)]
